title.rendered: Top 10 Travel Agencies in Dubai for Holiday Packages, Visas & Flights

content.rendered:
Dubai has more registered travel agencies and tour operators than almost any other city in the Middle East, which makes finding the best travel agency in Dubai harder than it should be. Between visa processing, flight bookings, holiday packages, and desert safaris, the right partner can save you money, time, and a lot of stress.

To make the decision easier, we researched and ranked the top 10 travel agencies in Dubai based on service range, licensing (IATA accreditation and Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism registration), customer reviews, years in operation, and pricing transparency.

Whether you need a UAE tourist visa, a cheap flight ticket, or a fully planned holiday package, this list covers the most trusted names in the industry.

How We Ranked These Dubai Travel Agencies

Before diving into the list, here’s the criteria used to evaluate each Dubai travel agency, tour operator, and destination management company (DMC):

  • Licensing and accreditation: IATA membership and Dubai DET (Department of Economy and Tourism) registration
  • Range of services: Flights, UAE and international visas, holiday packages, tours, transfers, and corporate travel
  • Customer reviews: Ratings on Google, Trustpilot, and TripAdvisor
  • Years in business and track record: Longevity and awards
  • Pricing transparency and payment flexibility: Clear quotes and multiple payment options
  • Local presence: Physical offices and responsive customer support in the UAE

With that in mind, here are the top 10 travel agencies in Dubai.

1. Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism

Website: gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com

Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism takes the top spot on this list as the best travel agency in Dubai for travelers who want a single, reliable partner for flights, visas, and holidays. Operating since 2015, Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism LLC is an IATA-accredited agency with offices in Bur Dubai and Abu Dhabi, focusing on serving the Filipino community in the UAE, and it has built a reputation around affordability, fast turnaround times, and genuinely broad service coverage.

Why Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism ranks #1:

  • Full-service offering: Cheap flight tickets, UAE tourist and residence visas, Schengen and international visas, curated holiday packages, guided tours, airport transfers, luxury travel, and even medical tourism packages through its dedicated Gulf Oasis Care division.
  • Proven track record: The agency reports over 1.2 million bookings, 350,000+ happy travelers, 200+ destinations covered, and 15 industry awards since launch.
  • Verified reputation: Strong, verifiable customer ratings across Google Reviews, Trustpilot, and TripAdvisor, plus recognition in Dubai tourism industry reports.
  • Visa specialists: Dedicated UAE visa change, UAE visa extension, and international visa services, a major pain point that many competitors don’t handle as thoroughly.
  • Flexible payments: Multiple payment options including buy-now-pay-later (Tabby) and newer options like crypto, GCash, and PayMaya, making bookings accessible for a wider range of travelers.
  • One-stop convenience: Holiday packages spanning Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas, so you’re not juggling multiple agencies for different trips.

Best for: Travelers who want a trusted, IATA-accredited, one-stop travel agency in Dubai for visas, flights, and holiday packages, backed by verified reviews and over a decade of local experience. Especially for the travellers from the Filipino community.

Contact: +971 56 520 7328 | info@gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com | Head Office: 1802, Fahidi Heights, Sharaf DG Metro Station Exit 4, Al Fahidi St, Bur Dubai, Dubai, UAE

2. Pinoy TravelBot

Website: pinoytravelbot.com

Pinoy TravelBot is a Dubai-based travel agency offering visa assistance, flight reservations, hotel bookings, airport transfers, holiday packages, and international visa support, with an added focus on serving the Filipino community in the UAE. It positions itself as an “AI-powered” travel assistant, offering personalized itinerary recommendations alongside more traditional booking services.

  • Services: UAE visa applications and visa change packages, international visa assistance, flight and hotel bookings, holiday tour packages, and airport transfers.
  • Industry partnerships: works with recognized travel technology and distribution partners, including Sabre, RateHawk, and BedsOnline, and is IATA-affiliated.
  • Locations: offices in Deira and Bur Dubai (UAE), Abu Dhabi, and Manila (Philippines).
  • Content hub: maintains an active blog covering visa and destination guides, including UAE digital nomad visa content.

Best for: Travelers, especially from the Filipino community, looking for visa assistance and holiday packages with a company that combines local UAE service with Manila-based support.

3. dnata Travel

Part of the Emirates Group, dnata Travel is one of the largest and longest-standing travel agencies in the region. It’s well known for holiday packages, cruise bookings, and multi-city itineraries, backed by strong airline partnerships and a wide retail branch network across the UAE.

Best for: Travelers who prefer a large, established brand with extensive airline and hotel partnerships.

4. Nirvana Travel and Tourism

Nirvana Travel and Tourism offers a balanced mix of leisure and corporate travel services. With a focus on personalized customer service, the company assists travelers with domestic and international travel planning.

Travelers looking for flexible holiday options often appreciate the company’s personalized travel assistance.

Best for: Family vacations, Leisure travel, Hotel Bookings and Business travel

5. Arabian Adventures

Arabian Adventures is a premier destination management company (DMC) known for desert safaris, dune bashing, cultural heritage tours, and sunset cruises. It has been recognized by the World Travel Awards for its desert safari and tour operator offerings.

Best for: Visitors who want curated in-UAE excursions and desert experiences rather than outbound holiday packages.

6. Rayna Tours & Travels

Rayna Tours is a well-established Dubai DMC offering UAE tours, attraction tickets, visa assistance, and short-haul outbound holiday packages. It’s a popular choice for both individual travelers and corporate groups.

Best for: Budget-friendly UAE activities bundled with quick regional getaways.

7. Musafir

Musafir is a Dubai-headquartered online and offline travel agency offering flight bookings, hotel reservations, and holiday packages across leisure and corporate travel. It has grown into a multi-country brand with a strong digital booking platform.

Best for: Travelers who prefer online self-service booking with the option of agent support.

8. Sharaf Travel

Sharaf Travel is known for its transparent, tech-enabled booking system and long-standing reputation in both outbound travel and inbound tourism to the UAE and Oman. Its Viewable Accounting System is a notable differentiator for corporate and repeat clients.

Best for: Corporate travel management and clients who prioritize transparent, auditable bookings.

9. Regal Tours Worldwide

Regal Tours Worldwide is well known for supporting visitors traveling to the UAE. The agency has extensive experience assisting tourists with visa processing and inbound travel arrangements.

Best for: UAE tourist visas, Dubai holidays, Airport transfers, and Short stay visitors

10. Al Tayer Travel

Al Tayer Travel serves travelers seeking premium travel experiences with an emphasis on quality, comfort, and personalized service.

Best for: Luxury holidays, Executive travel, International vacations, and Hotel reservations

Frequently Asked Questions

Which is the best travel agency in Dubai?

Based on service range, IATA accreditation, verified customer reviews, and years of operation, Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism is considered the best overall travel agency in Dubai for flights, visas, and holiday packages in 2026.

What should I look for in a Dubai travel agency?

Look for IATA accreditation, Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) registration, verified reviews on Google and Trustpilot, transparent pricing, and a service range that covers your specific needs, whether that’s visas, flights, or full holiday packages.

Is Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism a licensed travel agency?

Yes. Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism LLC is an IATA-accredited travel agency based in Dubai, operating since 2015, with additional offices in Abu Dhabi.

Can Dubai travel agencies help with UAE visa applications?

Most full-service Dubai travel agencies, including Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism, dnata Travel, Rayna Tours, and Musafir, offer UAE tourist visa, visa change, and visa extension services alongside flight and holiday bookings.

Do these agencies offer holiday packages outside the UAE?

Yes. Agencies like Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism, dnata Travel, and Emirates Holidays offer international holiday packages covering destinations across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas, in addition to UAE-based tours.

 

Conclusion

For travelers who want one dependable partner for visas, flights, and holiday packages, Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism stands out as the best travel agency in Dubai in 2026, combining IATA accreditation, a decade of operating history, verified customer reviews, and one of the broadest service catalogs on this list.

The other nine agencies each have their own strengths, from desert safaris to corporate MICE events, so the right choice ultimately depends on what kind of trip you’re planning.

Ready to book your next trip? Get in touch with Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism for a free, no-obligation quote on flights, visas, or holiday packages.
